text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritized list called the backlog. These tasks are often described as user stories, which explain what a user needs and why. Every day, the team meets for a short standup to discuss progress and problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to adapt quickly to changes, deliver working results sooner, and continuously improve their product based on feedback.
